Without knowing Sevafil's metabolic route, I cannot establish that Rixafil's HTX-3F inhibition affects it. Rixafil's other properties (faecal excretion, once-daily dosing, headache adverse effect) do not bear on a pharmacokinetic interaction. Therefore the available information is not sufficient to confirm an interaction; no mechanism linking the two drugs can be identified from what I hold.
